_comment: Nightly mutation testing (owner decision 2026-10-04) — Phase 1 scope:
the decision core only (metrics + routing). Report-only: the nightly run
never gates main; findings flow through triage. The contract is pinned
coverageAnalysis perTest + ignoreStatic keep runtime bounded; timeoutMS
is generous because several legitimate tests take 5-10s (rate-limit
waits, cooldown collapse) and a timeout would mask survivors as killed.
